objectives:
“1. Thermodynamics: To provides a macroscopic description of matters at equilibrium.
2. Quantum mechanics: To provides our microscopic description of the maters.
3. Statistical mechanics: To connects the microscopic, quantum mechanical description of constituent particles to
the macroscopic thermodynamic properties of matter.“
content:
1 The properties of gases (3 hrs)
2 The First Law: the concepts (6 hrs)
3* The First Law: the machinery (3 hrs)
4 The Second Law: the concepts  (6 hrs)
5 The Second Law: the machinery (6 hrs)
6 Physical transformations of pure substances (3 hrs)
7 Simple mixtures (6 hrs)
8 Phase diagram (3 hrs)
9* Chemical Equilibrium (3 hrs)
